title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, version bump v1.29.0
author: Sofia Chen
release_notes:
- Unify auth + retry behavior across Python/TS/Go SDKs
- Stabilize streaming API ergonomics (consistent async/iterator APIs)
- Parity fixes for method names and option flags across SDKs
- Version bump to v1.29.0
description:
Motivation: SDK users observed subtle differences between Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs around automatic auth refresh, retry/backoff defaults, and streaming APIs (iterator vs async callbacks). This caused confusion and duplicated support effort. This PR unifies auth token refresh semantics, standardizes retry/backoff defaults and policies, harmonizes streaming ergonomics (single unified streaming client surface across languages), and includes parity fixes and a version bump to v1.29.0.

What this PR does: - Implement a shared auth middleware pattern across all SDKs: automatic refresh on 401, single place to configure token providers and key rotation hooks. - Consolidate retry policies: default idempotent/non-idempotent behaviors, jittered exponential backoff, and a unified retry config exposed in all SDKs. - Streaming ergonomics: Python exposes both sync iterator and async iterator with identical semantics; TypeScript exposes async iterable + callback helper; Go exposes channel-based iterator + context cancellation helpers. - Parity fixes: align method names (create_embedding->embeddings.create), argument names (max_tokens -> maxOutputTokens where applicable), and deprecations with clear warnings. - Bump package versions to v1.29.0 and update changelogs.

Compatibility notes: All public methods are backward compatible by default. Where naming parity required small renames we preserved old names with deprecation warnings for one release. Auth behavior now retries a single token refresh on 401 before surfacing error (previously behavior varied). Retry defaults are more conservative (fewer retries for non-idempotent endpoints) to avoid accidental duplicate effects.

Checklist: - [x] Python changes implemented and unit tested - [x] TypeScript changes implemented and unit tested - [x] Go changes implemented and unit tested - [x] Integration tests for streaming and retry scenarios - [x] Changelog and migration notes added - [x] Docs updated (sdk auth + streaming ergonomics) - [x] Version bumps applied

Test plan: Ran unit suites for all SDKs in CI, added end-to-end streaming tests against canary runtime, simulated token expiry and ensured automatic refresh behavior, exercised retry/backoff in flaky network tests. CI initially surfaced a flaky e2e streaming test which was stabilized by increasing the default stream read timeout and fixing a race in the Go iterator finalizer.

Related: ENG-2024 (sdk parity/init), ENG-2031 (streaming ergonomics), SUP-5421 (customer report about inconsistent token refresh).
